CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
    If Not CurrentProject.AllForms("Frm_Costos").IsLoaded Then Cancel = True
End Sub

Private Sub btnEditar_Click()
    DoCmd.OpenForm "Frm_DatosCostos", , , , , , 2
    Call recuperaRegistro
End Sub

Private Sub btnEliminar_Click()
    If MsgBox("¿ESTA SEGURO DE ELIMINAR EL REGISTRO?", vbOKCancel + vbInformation, "Aviso") = vbOK Then
        CurrentDb.Execute "DELETE * FROM actividades WHERE id = " & Me.txtId & "", dbFailOnError
    End If
    Me.Form.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub recuperaRegistro()
    Dim rst As DAO.Recordset, SQL As String
    
    On Error GoTo ManipulaError
    SQL = "SELECT * FROM actividades WHERE id = " & Me.txtId & ""
    Set rst = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(SQL, dbOpenForwardOnly)
    With rst
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtId] = !id
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtCodSistema] = !codigoSistema
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![CCCodSemilla] = !codsemilla
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtfechasiembra] = !fechaSiembra
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtSemana] = !semanaAbono
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![CcActividad] = !Actividad
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtCantidad] = !cantidadAbono
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtnumeroPlantas] = !numeroPlantas
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtCosto] = !costo
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtUnidad] = !unidad
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtTotal] = !total
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtLote] = !lote
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtCama] = !cama
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtDescripcion] = !Detalle
        Forms![Frm_DatosCostos]![txtResponsable] = !responsable
    End With
    rst.Close: Set rst = Nothing
    
Salir:
    Exit Sub
    
ManipulaError:
    If Not rst Is Nothing Then rst.Close: Set rst = Nothing
    MsgBox Err.Description, vbCritical, "Atencion"
    Resume Salir
End Sub
